<function name="abs" parent="math" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Calculates the absolute value of a number (effectively removes any negative sign).</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="x" type="number">The number to get the absolute value of.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The absolute value.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Demonstrates what this function does.</description>
	<code>
print( math.abs( 15 ) )
print( math.abs( -15 ) )
	</code>
	<output>
```
15
15
```
	</output>
</example>
